documents.title: Electrical one-line, rev C (text extract)
documents.text: Utility A and Generator 1 feed ATS-1. Utility B and Generator 2 feed ATS-2. Switchgear A is fed from ATS-1 and switchgear B is fed from ATS-2. UPS-A is fed from SWGR-A. UPS-B is fed from SWGR-B. Pump MCC A is fed from ATS-1. Pump MCC B is fed from ATS-2. Chiller 1 fed from SWGR-A, chiller 2 fed from SWGR-B.

documents.title: ATS-2 replacement
documents.text: Scope: replace ATS-2 (end of life). To keep pump B running, MCC-B will be temporarily re-fed from ATS-1 via the tie breaker for the duration of the work. Restore MCC-B to ATS-2 after commissioning of the new switch.

documents.title: ATS-2 replacement, closeout
documents.text: New ATS-2 commissioned and load tested. Closeout items: as-builts to follow. Restoration of MCC-B feed deferred, see WO-4471.

documents.title: Restore pump MCC B normal feed
documents.text: Tech notes: found pump mcc b still back-fed from transfer sw 1 after the ATS-2 job. Tie breaker closed, ATS2 side open. Left as is per shift lead, needs outage window to restore. Status: on hold.

documents.title: Quarterly IR scan
documents.text: IR scan of electrical room. ATS1 carrying both pump MCCs, MCC-A and mcc B, load approx 32 kW. No hot spots. ATS-2 lightly loaded.

documents.title: Commissioning: pump rotation check
documents.text: During commissioning, MCC-B was briefly powered from ATS-1 on a temporary cable to check pump B rotation. Temporary cable removed the same day.

documents.title: Spare pump staging
documents.text: Staged PUMP-C on a skid. Proposed: PUMP-C would be fed from ATS-1 if it is ever installed. No work performed.

documents.title: CRAH 3 fan alarm
documents.text: CRAH-3 fan VFD fault, reset. Noted CRAH-3 is fed from swgr A per panel schedule. Belt tension ok.

documents.title: UPS battery test
documents.text: UPS A batt test passed, 8 min runtime at current load. UPS-B passed. ups-a fed from SWGR-A confirmed at input breaker.

documents.title: Chiller 2 controls upgrade
documents.text: Chiller 2 controls upgraded. CH-2 fed from SWGR-B unchanged. Planned: add CH-2 to the BMS trend list.

documents.title: PDU B1 breaker trip investigation
documents.text: PDU B1 tripped during load bank test, reset. PDU-B1 is fed from UPS-B. Rows 1 racks rode through on the A side.
